subject: English
learningObjectives: Recognize values such as respect for all living beings (including animals)
Develop empathy towards others' feelings and situations
Apply moral reasoning in difficult decisions related to right from wrong actions
Demonstrate tolerance by accepting differences among individuals
misconceptions: One person can do everything alone

vocabulary.honesty: Telling what is true without hiding facts or making excuses.
vocabulary.respect: Considering the feelings, rights, beliefs, etc. of others and treating them appropriately.
vocabulary.empathy: Understanding and sharing someone else's feelings as if they were your own.
vocabulary.tolerance: Acceptance and respect for opinions or habits that are different from one’s own.

storyBasedExplanation.title: The Kindness of Sunita: A Story on Value Education
storyBasedExplanation.content:
Sunita's small act turned into something big. The children not only learned to care for animals but also started helping their own parents at home in various little ways like picking up trash or comforting elderly neighbors.
Their school soon recognized the positive impact and decided that Sunita would host an annual 'Kindness Day' where everyone could participate in caring activities, proving once again how one small act of kindness can bring great changes.

teacherExplanation.title: Exploring Value Education Through Storytelling
teacherExplanation.content: Moreover, teachers can encourage role playing based on the story for kids which makes them feel empathy and respect towards living beings in a simulated environment.
